messages:
aisha: FYI posted the postmortem for the 03/21 latency spike. We need to lock SLO follow-ups + ownerships. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1768999999

 tom: 👍 skimmed it. TL;DR: p95 spiked due to model cache churn + autoscaler cooldown

 maria: Agree. We should change p95 target for embeddings-service route and add a dashboard panel for cache-hit by model

 aisha: Proposed SLO changes in the thread: ```
- embeddings.p95: 120ms -> 140ms (for peak 90th perc concurrency)
- generation.p99: 2.5s -> keep 2.5s
- overall-error-budget: 0.5% -> keep
```

 tom: I'd prefer to keep p95 at 120 and instead add circuit for cold-cache heavy requests; lower risk than loosening SLO

 ops_lead: We're on a monthly SLA with Customer X; any SLO loosen will impact them. Can we add routing rule first? @aisha

 aisha: Good point. Proposed plan: 1) Add dashboard + alert for cache-hit (owner: maria, ETA: 3d) 2) Add routing policy to send heavy requests to dedicated pool (owner: tom, ETA: 2w) 3) If no regression in 2w, reevaluate SLOs (owner: aisha, ETA: 3w) 4) Document fallback + SLA impact (owner: ops_lead, ETA: 1w)

 tom: I'll take routing policy. I'll open a PR with policy + tests.

 maria: Taking dashboard + alert. I'll attach panel screenshots in this thread once ready.

 ops_lead: I'll draft customer note and confirm SLA implications. ETA EOD Fri.

 infra-bot: Deploy window for routing policy changes opens Mon 03/30 02:00-04:00 UTC — ping @tom to schedule.

 aisha: Adding recurring check for incident pattern: add a weekly query that reports model churn vs latency spikes; owner: maria; recurring: weekly

 tom: Question: how do we track error budget consumption pre/post change? Recommend adding an SLI export to BigQuery (owner: sre-oncall)

 sre-oncall: I can do the SLI export. ETA 5d. I'll also wire a dashboard that shows EB burn rate.

 aisha: Cool. Confirming action list and owners. I'll create an internal taskboard and link it here. Anyone object to the plan?

 maria: No objections. One ask — add playbook note for rollback steps if routing policy causes regressions.

 tom: +1

 aisha: ok thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the taskboard link shortly :raised_hands:
